verification_policy: Single-skill Strike Super research: verify canonical identity, acquisition route, cost, usability, and mechanics; preserve unsupported values as null.
research_scope: Sonic Rush — Strike Super / Future Gohan mentor research.

verification_audit.method: Compared repository coverage with current Xenoverse 2-specific skill documentation and independent Dragon Ball documentation.

duplicate_check.identity_note: No existing repository research batch for Sonic Rush was found. Canonical identity is Super / Strike.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Xenoverse 2 documentation classifies Sonic Rush as a Strike Super Attack.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Sonic Rush is obtained through Future Gohan's mentor training, specifically Lesson 1. The lesson reward is documented as Sonic Rush despite a historical plot-description naming discrepancy.
verification_audit.finish_policy: ultimate_finish_required remains null because the documented acquisition route is mentor training rather than a Parallel Quest reward.
verification_audit.cost_policy: Ki cost is documented as 100; stamina cost remains null.

records.name: Sonic Rush
records.character_source: Gohan (Future) / Trunks (Future) Customize Partner / Jiren Customize Partner
records.skill_description: Charge forward and unleash a short-range strike rush of punches and kicks that ends by knocking the opponent down.
records.mechanics_notes: The Xenoverse 2 reference describes a side kick followed by a barrage of punches and kicks ending in a knockdown. It is documented as a six-hit Strike Super with hard-knockdown behavior. Later updates changed its ability to connect against knocked-back opponents, so version-sensitive details are kept descriptive.
records.acquisition_notes: Future Gohan's Lesson 1 is the canonical acquisition route. Independent documentation notes that an older plot description calls the lesson reward Future Rush while the actual listed skill reward is Sonic Rush; this naming discrepancy does not change the canonical skill identity.
records.pve_notes: Mentor-training acquisition; no Parallel Quest or Ultimate Finish requirement established.
records.pvp_notes: Short-range rush attack with tracking/chase utility after knockback. Update history confirms later hit-confirmation improvements; exact frame behavior is not encoded as canonical numeric data.
